Max's Night CabCollateralOne night. Five stops. Plenty of snacks.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCab driver's pretzel, peanut and jerky mixPretzels, peanuts and cashews roasted in smoked paprika butter, with beef jerkyHow to make it150g pretzels150g salted peanuts100g cashews40g butter1 tsp smoked paprika1 tbsp brown sugar100g beef jerkyToss the pretzels, salted peanuts and cashews with melted butter, paprika and sugar.Roast at 160°C.Cool.Tip into paper bags with strips of jerky.Koreatown nightclub fried chickenDouble fried wings glazed in gochujang honey sauceHow to make it1kg chicken wings100g potato starch2 L vegetable oil2 tbsp gochujang2 tbsp soy sauce3 tbsp honey2 garlic cloves1 tbsp sesame seedsToss the wings in the starch.Heat the oil to 160°C and fry the wings in batches, then rest.Fry again at 190°C until shattering.Simmer the gochujang, soy, honey and garlic until glossy.Toss the wings in the sauce and top with sesame.MainsLate night carne asada tacosLime and orange marinated skirt steak, seared and sliced into corn tortillasHow to make it800g skirt steak2 limes1 orange3 garlic cloves1 tsp ground cumin16 corn tortillas1 white onion1 bunch coriander1 jar salsa rojaMarinate the steak in lime and orange juice, garlic and cumin.Sear over very high heat.Rest, then slice against the grain.Warm the tortillas. Chop the onion and coriander.Serve in tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.Ida's hospital chicken noodle soupMax's mum Ida in hospital, in the middle of it allHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs simmered into a golden broth with onion, carrot and celery, shredded back in with egg noodles, dill, black pepper and a squeeze of lemon.Put 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in a pot with 2L water, an onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and a bay leaf.Simmer gently for 1 hour, skimming.Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and dice the vegetables.Return both to the strained broth, add 200g egg noodles and simmer 5 minutes.Season well and finish with chopped dill and lemon juice.SweetsIsland dream coconut tartBaked coconut custard in a sweet shortcrust shellHow to make it2 sheets of sweet shortcrust pastry200g desiccated coconut3 eggs150g caster sugar80g butter200ml coconut milkLine a tart tin with the pastry and blind-bake.Whisk the coconut, eggs, sugar, melted butter and coconut milk.Pour in and bake at 170°C until golden and set.Cool.DrinksMax's cab Vietnamese iced coffeeStrong dark roast coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and iceHow to make it80g dark roast ground coffee500ml boiling water8 tbsp sweetened condensed milk1 pinch salt1 bag iceBrew the ground coffee with the boiling water to make very strong coffee.Put condensed milk and a pinch of salt in each of four tall glasses.Pour hot coffee into each and stir until combined.Fill with ice, stir again and serve with a straw.
